projection_contract.source_revision_rule: Record the exact observed source commit/tree and a deterministic source-scope fingerprint. A tracked projection cannot name its containing commit without a hash cycle. check recomputes current HEAD/tree and source scope, verifies the recorded revision exists and has the same declared source scope, and reports exact current HEAD separately.
permitted_exclusions: immutable validation/review evidence added after source validation
projection_contract.exclusion_limit: Every exclusion is explicit and reasoned; governance, implementation, tests, schemas and authoritative dossier inputs may never be excluded. Evidence hashes are independently validated; a new evidence-only commit is not a semantic source change.
projection_contract.ledger_binding: Read-only direct live ledger verification at the explicit configured root; no copied tasks/roster/events; differing or missing hashes make projection stale.
